rationale: The Court is likely to reverse narrowly on AEDPA/Strickland “double deference,” emphasizing that the Ninth Circuit impermissibly reweighed mitigation and revisited credibility rather than asking whether the state court’s no-prejudice determination was beyond fairminded disagreement. Sotomayor likely dissents on the view that Arizona’s nexus-inflected reasoning functionally excluded mitigation in violation of Eddings/Lockett, while one or more conservatives may concur to stress habeas limits and reject any nexus-based carveout.
